existing_args_kept.m29_semantics: Final global output cap after policy selection.
Legacy detector-order cap only; when candidate-selection-policy is cap-aware, this must not truncate candidates before policy ranking.
Prompt budget remains fixed at the E003-M26 value, so M29 isolates proposal selection from prompt coverage.

new_or_changed_args.purpose: Select whether detector proposals are written in detector order or ranked before final caps.
Score raw projected candidates before spatial consolidation and label-balanced caps.
Retain at most this many candidates per scan and canonical label before the global output cap.
Suppress lower-scored candidates of the same scan/label within this world-coordinate radius.
Drop resolved labels that are not active for the current scan prompt set before ranking.
Safety cap for raw projected candidates before policy selection; it is not a paper metric cap.
Write policy diagnostics beside real_proposals.jsonl for reproducibility.
